note: The FPA list of banned and restricted pesticides, in our own words.

items.say: The FPA bans deltamethrin on banana.
The FPA bans fipronil on banana when it is injected into the bud. Use it only as its label says.
The FPA restricts paraquat to institutional use, by approved users only.
The FPA allows monocrotophos only against beanfly on legumes.
The FPA allows methidathion only in banana plantations.
The FPA allows fenamiphos only in banana and pineapple plantations.
The FPA allows lindane only on pineapple plantations, in the soil before planting.
The FPA does not allow aldicarb to be imported except in an emergency it declares.
The FPA has banned endosulfan since 2015. Do not use old stock.
The FPA bans this ingredient. Do not use it.
